pairs.subject: design-tokens
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:67 The kit's own motion specimens play at hand-typed durations (.9s here, .4s for shake) that sit outside the source.json ladder (.15s / .3s / .6s), so the page meant to show the motion system as shipped shows values the vocabulary never issued, and retuning the ladder will not reach them.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:67 0.9s is an in-between duration with no ladder step (the motion group holds only dur-fast .15s, dur .3s and dur-slow .6s), and .playMoved repeats it. Only .playFade uses var(--dur). There is a second problem: under reduced motion the global block sets `animation: none !important` (exactly zero, not near-zero). Motion.tsx:209 clears its state on onAnimationEnd, which then never fires, so a repeated press of the same act stays stuck. That is the completion-event break the technique names.

app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:70 This is a raw duration with no easing token, and it passes the token gate. The kit's module CSS is inside the gate's walk (pipeline/check-tokens.mts scans app/(studio)), but packages/ui/src/tokenLint.ts only checks colour literals, px literals and unknown var() names. Durations, em lengths and opacity in this file are invisible to it, so the gate has a measured recall gap on the motion axis.

app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:12 The kit's chrome (nav, cards, labels) uses tokens that source.json marks tier=primitive (--cyan, --ink-bright, --hair, --faint, --r-sm, --sp-N) directly. That is the skipped-layer anti-pattern. The token swatches themselves painting primitives through var() are legitimate specimen use. The page's own layout rules are not.

app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:52 Specimens read the authority itself, not a hand-listed copy. Each swatch paints through var(--name), so a token that fails to load shows as missing. page.tsx:62 also flags any source group with no kit section via an ErrorLine. The scripted duration consumer (Motion.tsx) uses a completion event, not a timed wait.

packages/ui/tokens/source.json:2 The source has one binding set (a single :root). A search for prefers-color-scheme and data-theme across app/ and packages/ui/src found nothing, so there is no theme switch for the kit to branch on. Nothing in the kit asks which theme it is in.

pairs.registryProposal: token-taxonomy's skipped-layer rule ("any primitive reference outside role/theme definitions") makes no exception for a token-specimen surface, whose whole job is to paint every primitive. The technique could say that specimen rendering of each token is an allowed primitive consumer, while the specimen page's own chrome is not. Without that, a gate that tests the tier field either flags the kit wholesale or exempts the kit's directory, and a directory exemption is the silent exclusion token-enforcement forbids.
